name: What is the process of a foundation retrofit?

mainEntity.name: What is the process of a foundation retrofit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The foundation retrofit process typically begins with a thorough inspection and assessment by a structural engineer or contractor to identify specific weaknesses. Based on this, a detailed plan is developed. The work usually involves clearing access to the crawl space, then bolting the house frame to the foundation, often using anchor bolts or L-shaped brackets. Cripple walls are reinforced with plywood bracing. Finally, all work is inspected to ensure it meets local building codes and seismic safety standards, providing enhanced protection against earthquakes.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves inspection, planning, bolting the house to the foundation, bracing cripple walls, and final inspection to meet codes.
